entries.old_zh: 灰袍守卫起源于统一帝国时期的巡察警队。帝国覆灭后，这支以女性为主体的警察家族没有随旧秩序一同消失，而是以家族血脉、修会戒律与旧帝国法统维系自身。她们巡察道路，缉捕罪犯，调停私斗，也为仍愿守法之人留下赎罪与归正的门。对许多百姓而言，灰袍不是寻常贵族，更像一支身披灰袍、持戒而行的世俗修女警团。

sources.english: The Grey Wardens trace their charge to the constabulary of the old, undivided Empire. When the Empire broke apart, this sisterhood of lawkeepers did not perish with the former order. Blood, rule, and the lawful tradition of the old Empire bound them together. They ride the roads, seize malefactors, settle private feuds, and leave a road back to lawful conduct for those willing to atone. To many common folk, the Grey Wardens are less a noble house than a secular order of grey-robed sisters sworn to keep the peace.

old_en: The Grey Wardens trace their charge to the constabulary of the old, undivided Empire. When the Empire broke apart, this sisterhood of lawkeepers did not perish with the former order. Blood, rule, and the lawful tradition of the old Empire bound them together. They ride the roads, seize malefactors, settle private feuds, and leave a road back to lawful conduct for those willing to atone. To many common folk, the Grey Wardens are less a noble house than a secular order of grey-robed sisters sworn to keep the peace.
entries.new_zh: 灰袍起初是帝国教会中承担巡察与惩戒的一支修会。帝国分裂后，她们脱离了诸侯的统辖，仍奉上天的诫命约束自身，也要求旁人守戒。修会由女性统领，教士在各地传教，村中的教众为她们提供兵员与供给。她们缉捕劫掠者，保护村庄与商路，并把惩戒罪行视为信仰的一部分。平民依靠她们的庇护，也畏惧她们严苛的审判。
entries.new_en: The Grey Wardens began as an order within the Imperial priesthood, charged with patrol and punishment. After the Empire fractured, they broke from the rule of its lords but continued to bind themselves and others to Heaven's commandments. Women command the order, priests preach its faith, and village congregations supply recruits and provisions. They pursue raiders and protect villages and trade routes, regarding punishment as a religious duty. The common folk rely on their protection and fear the severity of their judgment.
entries.context: 家族百科总介绍；出身、政教分离与严苛惩戒为按用户方向拟写的模组设定，非原版事实。

entries.old_zh: 我们是灰袍守卫，承自统一帝国旧制的警察家族。帝国已崩，法统未绝；王朝可以更替，街巷、村庄与道路仍需有人巡察。世人把我们当作家族也好，当作修会也罢，于我们并无分别。只要百姓仍呼唤公道，灰袍便会回应。

sources.english: We are the Grey Wardens, a constabulary house descended from the institutions of the old, undivided Empire. The Empire is broken, yet lawful succession endures. Dynasties may rise and fall; streets, villages, and roads must still be watched. Call us a clan or call us an order—it is all one to us. So long as the common folk cry out for justice, the Grey Wardens shall answer.

old_en: We are the Grey Wardens, a constabulary house descended from the institutions of the old, undivided Empire. The Empire is broken, yet lawful succession endures. Dynasties may rise and fall; streets, villages, and roads must still be watched. Call us a clan or call us an order—it is all one to us. entries.new_zh: 我们是灰袍，奉上天的诫命巡察各地。修会不受诸侯差遣。有人劫掠村庄、袭击行旅，我们就会追捕，不论他为谁效命。
entries.new_en: We are the Grey Wardens, bound by Heaven's commandments to watch over these lands. The order answers to no lord. We pursue those who raid villages or attack travellers, whoever they serve.

entries.old_zh: {HERO_NAME}常被派往受灾村镇、饥荒边地和战后余波最重的地区。她擅长安抚、分配、调停和维持最基础的公共秩序，因此在百姓中的名声尤为温和。很多人第一次理解灰袍，并不是因为看见她们缉捕罪犯，而是因为看见她们在最混乱的时候，仍先替普通人把日子重新扶正。

sources.english: {HERO_NAME} is often sent where villages have suffered disaster, famine grips the marches, or war has left its deepest scars. She is skilled in relief, allotment, mediation, and the restoration of the simplest public order, and the common folk speak gently of her. Many first understand the Grey Wardens not when they see a criminal seized, but when they see ordinary lives set upright again amid the worst confusion.

old_en: {HERO_NAME} is often sent where villages have suffered disaster, famine grips the marches, or war has left its deepest scars. She is skilled in relief, allotment, mediation, and the restoration of the simplest public order, and the common folk speak gently of her. Many first understand the Grey Wardens not when they see a criminal seized, but when they see ordinary lives set upright again amid the worst confusion.
entries.new_zh: {HERO_NAME}负责战后的村庄重建。追兵离开以后，她往往还留在村里，安排人手修屋、清井，帮助流散的人家回来。她把这些劳作视作应尽的侍奉，与追捕劫掠者同样要紧。
entries.new_en: {HERO_NAME} oversees the rebuilding of villages after war. When the pursuit has moved on, she often remains to arrange repairs, clear wells, and help scattered families return. She regards this work as a duty of faith, as necessary as pursuing the raiders.
entries.context: 创始领主晨曦的百科介绍，对应重建；修屋清井是重建的叙事描写，不新增工程功能。

entries.old_zh: {HERO_NAME}最常驰往村民在路上遭袭、或田野上升起浓烟的地方。她记得那些被烧毁村庄的名字，并以普通家庭能否不再沦为战争战利品、安心劳作和出行为尺度衡量法律。那些以农民为猎物的人已经知道，一旦村庄受到威胁，她安静的态度便会立刻结束。

sources.english: {HERO_NAME} rides most often where villagers have been struck on the road or where smoke rises above the fields. She remembers the names of burned hamlets and measures the law by whether ordinary families can work and travel without becoming spoils of war. Those who prey upon peasants have learned that her quiet manner ends the moment a village is threatened.

old_en: {HERO_NAME} rides most often where villagers have been struck on the road or where smoke rises above the fields. She remembers the names of burned hamlets and measures the law by whether ordinary families can work and travel without becoming spoils of war. Those who prey upon peasants have learned that her quiet manner ends the moment a village is threatened.
entries.new_zh: {HERO_NAME}负责村庄遇袭后的追捕。她记得不少被烧毁的村名，也熟悉村民逃难时常走的小路。接到劫掠的消息，她便召集人手出发；在她看来，是否入教都不能成为任人劫杀的理由。
entries.new_en: {HERO_NAME} pursues those who attack villages. She remembers the names of many burned settlements and knows the paths their people take when fleeing. News of a raid sends her gathering riders; she holds that no one's faith can excuse their being robbed or killed.
entries.context: 创始领主弥瑟的百科介绍；拟稿中的保护不限信仰来自“保护平民”方向，不增添信仰筛选机制。

entries.old_zh: {HERO_NAME}尤其留意那些无法归入旧卷宗的请求，特别是由足以改变天下格局的旅人直接带给灰袍的请求。对于没有先例的事，她不会轻易许诺，却也很少只因旧日书记官从未设想过便驳回。六人之中，人们最常向她询问法律下一步应当变成什么。

sources.english: {HERO_NAME} keeps an uncommon watch for petitions that do not fit the old rolls, especially those carried directly to the Grey Wardens by travellers whose deeds have altered the realm. She is slow to promise what precedent has not yet defined, yet rarely dismisses a request merely because no former clerk imagined it. Among the six, she is the one most often asked what the law should become next.

old_en: {HERO_NAME} keeps an uncommon watch for petitions that do not fit the old rolls, especially those carried directly to the Grey Wardens by travellers whose deeds have altered the realm. She is slow to promise what precedent has not yet defined, yet rarely dismisses a request merely because no former clerk imagined it. Among the six, she is the one most often asked what the law should become next.
entries.new_zh: {HERO_NAME}替修会接待贵族的申诉，尤其留意灰袍成员遭受的不公。她会先问清事情的经过，再召集有关的人公开议决。旧例不能解决的事，她也愿意带回修会商议。
entries.new_en: {HERO_NAME} receives appeals from nobles for the order, with particular concern for wrongs done to its members. She first hears what happened, then brings those concerned before a public decision. When precedent offers no answer, she takes the matter back to the order for discussion.
entries.context: 创始领主暮光的百科介绍，对应贵族事务。

entries.old_zh: {HERO_NAME}保存着旧日统一帝国传下的法令与判例，但她很少长久留在档案室。村庄首领、城镇商人、工匠，甚至巷道中更强硬的人物，都见过她前来听取尚未解决的请求，并留下来直到事由被撤回或得到解决。她认为，旧法律只有仍能平息当下的纠纷时，才证明自身价值。

sources.english: {HERO_NAME} preserves the statutes and judgments inherited from the old, undivided Empire, but she seldom remains long beside the archive. Village headmen, town merchants, artisans, and even the harder figures of the alleys have seen her arrive, hear an unresolved petition, and stay until its cause is withdrawn or settled. She holds that an old law proves its worth only when it can still quiet a living grievance.

old_en: {HERO_NAME} preserves the statutes and judgments inherited from the old, undivided Empire, but she seldom remains long beside the archive. Village headmen, town merchants, artisans, and even the harder figures of the alleys have seen her arrive, hear an unresolved petition, and stay until its cause is withdrawn or settled. She holds that an old law proves its worth only when it can still quiet a living grievance.
entries.new_zh: {HERO_NAME}为修会听取各地请愿。村庄首领、商人和工匠都可能向她陈述争端，她也会走进巷道询问那些不愿见官的人。她随身带着旧帝国的法令，用它们辨明案情，再依修会的戒律主持调解。
entries.new_en: {HERO_NAME} hears petitions for the order. Village headmen, merchants, and artisans bring disputes before her, and she enters the alleys to question those unwilling to approach an official. She carries old Imperial statutes to help establish the facts, then mediates under the order's rule.
entries.context: 创始领主圣铎的百科介绍，对应要人请愿。

entries.old_zh: {HERO_NAME}是现任灰袍统领，也是旧日统一帝国巡法体系最清晰的在世继承者之一。黎明前，人们常在操练场看见她纠正盾墙，或要求老兵向新兵说明纪律为何重于炫技。对外，她禁止灰袍追逐王冠与领地；对内，她坚持让每一位宣誓者都做好准备，在法律必须以武力守卫时稳住道路。

sources.english: {HERO_NAME} is the present Warden-General and one of the clearest living heirs to the constabulary of the old, undivided Empire. She is often found in the drill yard before dawn, correcting a shield line or making veterans teach recruits why discipline matters more than display. Beyond their walls she forbids the Grey Wardens to seek crowns or widen estates; within, she insists that every sworn daughter be made ready to hold the road when law must be defended by force.

old_en: {HERO_NAME} is the present Warden-General and one of the clearest living heirs to the constabulary of the old, undivided Empire. She is often found in the drill yard before dawn, correcting a shield line or making veterans teach recruits why discipline matters more than display. Beyond their walls she forbids the Grey Wardens to seek crowns or widen estates; within, she insists that every sworn daughter be made ready to hold the road when law must be defended by force.
entries.new_zh: {HERO_NAME}是灰袍现任统领，负责训练修会的战士。她常在天亮前检阅新兵，要求老兵亲自纠正盾墙的空隙。她相信守护百姓是上天交给灰袍的职责，不许部下以修会之名争夺王位或扩张私产。
entries.new_en: {HERO_NAME} is the present Warden-General and oversees the training of the order's soldiers. Before dawn she often inspects recruits and has veterans close the gaps in their shield wall. She believes Heaven has charged the Wardens with protecting the common folk, and forbids them to use the order to pursue crowns or enlarge private estates.
entries.context: 创始领主梵蒂的百科介绍，对应练兵本职。

entries.old_zh: {HERO_NAME}长期负责旧帝国驿道与乡野巡察。她最常出现在边远道路、渡口与商旅往来的要冲，处理盗匪、私斗与沿途勒索。许多行商与村民先记住她的灰袍，再记住她的名字。对平民而言，她代表的是一种朴素却可靠的事实：帝国虽然已经崩塌，但仍有人在守路。

sources.english: {HERO_NAME} has long kept watch over the post roads and countryside of the old Empire. She is most often found upon distant tracks, ferries, and the crossings of merchants, settling brigandage, blood-feuds, and unlawful tolls. Many traders and villagers remember the grey mantle before they learn her name. To them she embodies a plain and steadfast truth: the Empire has broken, yet someone still keeps the road.

old_en: {HERO_NAME} has long kept watch over the post roads and countryside of the old Empire. She is most often found upon distant tracks, ferries, and the crossings of merchants, settling brigandage, blood-feuds, and unlawful tolls. Many traders and villagers remember the grey mantle before they learn her name. To them she embodies a plain and steadfast truth: the Empire has broken, yet someone still keeps the road.
entries.new_zh: {HERO_NAME}负责保护商路，常在桥梁、渡口和集市之间奔走。她追查商队遇袭与沿途勒索，不肯把这些事当作战争中无须过问的小事。走这几条路的商人，许多都认得她的灰袍。
entries.new_en: {HERO_NAME} protects the trade roads, riding between bridges, ferries, and markets. She pursues attacks on caravans and unlawful tolls, refusing to dismiss them as ordinary wartime losses. Many who trade along these roads know her grey mantle.
entries.context: 创始领主约珥的百科介绍，对应商队护卫。

entries.old_zh: 你的记录里有些问题。不过只要你愿意改正，灰袍仍然会给你机会。

sources.english: There are problems in your record. If you are willing to correct them, the Grey Wardens will still give you that chance.

old_en: There are problems in your record. If you are willing to correct them, the Grey Wardens will still give you that chance.
entries.new_zh: 你做过的事，我们有所耳闻。肯改过，就还有挽回的余地。
entries.new_en: We have heard something of your deeds. Make amends, and there is still a way back.
entries.context: 已认识领主随机问候，玩家声望为负但未达通缉分支。

entries.old_zh: 你的记录不错。只要你继续遵守规矩、愿意帮助需要的人，我们就会把你当作值得信任的同伴。

sources.english: Your record is good. Keep following the rules and helping people who need it, and we will treat you as someone we can trust.

old_en: Your record is good. Keep following the rules and helping people who need it, and we will treat you as someone we can trust.
entries.new_zh: 你为百姓做过些好事。有话请说。
entries.new_en: You have done some good for the common folk. Speak your mind.
entries.context: 已认识领主随机问候，玩家声望5至19。

entries.old_zh: 我看过你的记录。你一直在帮助受害者，也没有给我们添麻烦。这样的表现，灰袍会记住。

sources.english: I have read your record. You have consistently helped victims without causing trouble for us. The Grey Wardens remember that kind of work.

old_en: I have read your record. You have consistently helped victims without causing trouble for us. The Grey Wardens remember that kind of work.
entries.new_zh: 你帮过那些受害的人，灰袍记得这份情。
entries.new_en: You have helped those who suffered. The Wardens remember it.
entries.context: 已认识领主随机问候，玩家声望20至39。

entries.old_zh: 我们会记录每个人做过的事，包括功劳和过错。目前你的记录没有问题，我愿意听你说。

sources.english: We keep track of what people do, both the good and the bad. At the moment, your record gives me no reason to turn you away.

old_en: We keep track of what people do, both the good and the bad. At the moment, your record gives me no reason to turn you away.
entries.new_zh: 说吧，你找灰袍有什么事？
entries.new_en: What brings you to the Grey Wardens?
entries.context: 已认识领主随机问候，玩家声望0至4。

entries.old_zh: 我听过不少关于你的好话。村民和商人都说你愿意帮忙，也守规矩。继续这样做，灰袍会放心把更重要的事情交给你。

sources.english: I have heard a lot of good things about you. Villagers and merchants say you help when you can and respect the rules. Keep that up, and the Grey Wardens will trust you with more important work.

old_en: I have heard a lot of good things about you. Villagers and merchants say you help when you can and respect the rules. Keep that up, and the Grey Wardens will trust you with more important work.
entries.new_zh: 沿途的村民和商人都称赞过你。灰袍信得过肯为百姓办事的人。
entries.new_en: Villagers and merchants along the road have spoken well of you. The Wardens trust those who act for the common folk.
entries.context: 已认识的灰袍领主随机问候，玩家灰袍声望至少40；阈值仅在此说明，不放进台词。

entries.old_zh: 你的问题已经很严重了。如果你继续违法，下次见面我们就会直接采取行动。

sources.english: Your situation is already serious. If you keep breaking the law, the next Grey Warden you meet will take action instead of offering another warning.

old_en: Your situation is already serious. If you keep breaking the law, the next Grey Warden you meet will take action instead of offering another warning.
entries.new_zh: 你再劫掠百姓，灰袍就会来追捕你。
entries.new_en: Prey on the common folk again, and the Wardens will come for you.
entries.context: 已认识领主随机问候，玩家声望不高于-40；不将阈值当作新的追捕机制。

entries.old_zh: 你涉及的案件还没有结束。我可以先听你解释，但这不代表事情已经过去。

sources.english: The case involving you is still open. I can hear your explanation, but that does not mean the matter is over.

old_en: The case involving you is still open. I can hear your explanation, but that does not mean the matter is over.
entries.new_zh: 你的案子还没有了结。先说说你的来意。
entries.new_en: Your case is not settled. Tell me why you have come.
entries.context: 已认识领主随机问候，玩家声望-39至-11。

entries.old_zh: 好，说吧。你找我有什么事？

sources.english: All right. Tell me what you need.

old_en: All right. Tell me what you need.
entries.new_en: What do you need?
entries.context: 上述随机问候后的衔接句；原逻辑可能与上一句重复，拟稿不改对话流。

entries.old_zh: {VAR_1}是在{VAR_2}遭劫掠焚毁后，被灰袍守卫带回内院收养的女娃。她尚年幼，却已经在耳濡目染中听惯了巡路口令、案卷誊录与修会戒律。对灰袍而言，她不是寻常意义上的家族血亲，而是从灾厄中被接续下来的下一代誓女。

sources.english: After {VAR_2} was sacked and put to the torch, the Grey Wardens took the girl {VAR_1} into their inner ward. Though still young, she has grown accustomed to patrol calls, copied depositions, and the discipline of the order. To the Wardens she is no common kinswoman, but a sworn daughter carried forward from calamity.

old_en: After {VAR_2} was sacked and put to the torch, the Grey Wardens took the girl {VAR_1} into their inner ward. Though still young, she has grown accustomed to patrol calls, copied depositions, and the discipline of the order. To the Wardens she is no common kinswoman, but a sworn daughter carried forward from calamity.
entries.new_zh: {VAR_1}在{VAR_2}遭劫焚毁后被灰袍收养，如今住在修会内院。她还年幼，已熟悉巡察队出门时的口令，也跟着长辈学习戒律。
entries.new_en: The Grey Wardens took {VAR_1} in after {VAR_2} was sacked and burned. She now lives within the order's house. Still young, she knows the patrol calls and learns the commandments from her elders.
entries.context: 收养女孩不足12岁时的百科介绍。

entries.old_zh: {VAR_1}幼时曾在{VAR_2}遭焚后被灰袍守卫收养。如今的她已开始学习识卷、抄录口供、辨识罪案与巡路礼仪，在长辈眼中，她正从劫后余生的孤女逐渐成长为灰袍内院受训的新一代后继者。

sources.english: The Grey Wardens adopted {VAR_1} in childhood, after {VAR_2} was burned. She now learns to read case rolls, copy testimony, discern offences, and observe the rites of the road. In her elders’ eyes, the orphan who survived the flames is becoming an heir trained within the inner ward.

old_en: The Grey Wardens adopted {VAR_1} in childhood, after {VAR_2} was burned. She now learns to read case rolls, copy testimony, discern offences, and observe the rites of the road. In her elders’ eyes, the orphan who survived the flames is becoming an heir trained within the inner ward.
entries.new_zh: {VAR_1}幼时在{VAR_2}被焚后由灰袍收养。她正在修会学习读写、辨认案情和遵守戒律，为成年后的职责做准备。
entries.new_en: The Wardens adopted {VAR_1} after {VAR_2} was burned in her childhood. She is learning to read, examine cases, and follow the order's rule in preparation for her adult duties.
